title: Florida Bay Buoy Explorer
text: This site hosts static Quarto dashboards for exploring Everglades National Park buoy data from SECOORA ERDDAP.

title: Florida Bay Buoy Explorer
text:
Dashboards

Current vs Usual → — compare today’s readings to each buoy’s past-year distribution and seasonal range
Salinity & Temperature Maps → — paired salinity and temperature maps side by side, with hourly interpolated fields
Salinity Dashboard → — salinity overview, interpolated fields, and station gauges
Station Clustering → — hierarchical clustering of buoys by salinity and temperature statistics

The dashboards reuse interpolation and mapping methods from the south-florida-salinity project:

Leaflet htmlwidgets for interactive buoy maps (Quarto htmlwidgets)
DIVAnd variational analysis with bathymetry-aware land masking
Hourly field panels at 06:00, 12:00, 18:00, and 24:00 US Eastern

title: Florida Bay Buoy Explorer
text:
Build locally
quarto render
To publish as a static site on GitHub Pages:
make publish
